newsitem.title: USA: N.Y. Power Authority 825 MW plant up after repairs.
newsitem.headline: N.Y. Power Authority 825 MW plant up after repairs.

text.p: New York Power Authority's 825 megawatt Poletti power station in Queens, N.Y., returned to operation today, as expected, following repairs to a boiler tube, the utility said Monday.
"We went back on line 0441 (EDT) this morning. Repairs were completed at 1630 Sunday," said company spokesmn Dick Mathiew.
The generating station was shut last Thursday after crews discovered a leak in a boiler tube.
The Poletti plant, the largest fossil fuel plant operated by the state-owned utility, can burn either fuel oil or natural gas to produce electricity.
